title: Ex-Kenyan leader Raila Odinga buried after days of memorial events
summary: Supporters of the long-time opposition leaders have held several days of massive events to mark his death.

title: Israel Suspends Aid and Strikes Gaza After Accusing Hamas of Violating Truce
summary: Israel said Palestinian militants attacked its forces across cease-fire lines and launched a wave of attacks on Gaza. Both sides still say they are committed to the truce.
